context.content: I have hacked together a bookmarklet that appends web page info to a note containing a list of books I want to read. It can be used for any lists... javascript:location.href='bear://x-callback-url/add-text?id=**note identifier**&mode=append&text='+encodeURIComponent(location.href)+'\xa0('+encodeURIComponent(document.title)+')\xa0'+encodeURIComponent(window.getSelection())
